preToolUse.description: Block hardcoded secrets in file writes (CLI + VS Code) — denies with session-level additionalContext per v4 pattern
preToolUse.bash:
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cat <<'JSON_EOF'
{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Hook enforcement unavailable: jq is not installed. Install jq (brew install jq / apt install jq / choco install jq).","additionalContext":"REPOSITORY POLICY: enforcement hooks require jq. Do NOT retry via alternate tools. Install jq and re-run.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Hook enforcement unavailable: jq is not installed."}}
JSON_EOF
  exit 0
fi
INPUT=$(cat)
TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.toolName // .tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null)
ARGS=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -c 'if (.toolArgs|type)=="string" then (try (.toolArgs|fromjson) catch {}) elif (.toolArgs|type)=="object" then .toolArgs elif (.tool_input|type)=="object" then .tool_input else {} end' 2>/dev/null)
CONTENT=$(echo "$ARGS" | jq -r '.content // .new_string // .newString // empty' 2>/dev/null)
CMD=$(echo "$ARGS" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null)

hit_content=0
if [ -n "$CONTENT" ]; then
  hit_content=$(echo "$CONTENT" | while IFS= read -r line; do
    echo "$line" | grep -qiE '(password|secret|token|api[_-]?key)\s*[:=]' 2>/dev/null || continue
    echo "$line" | sed -E 's/^.*[:=][[:space:]]*//' | grep -qE '^[$][{(]' 2>/dev/null && continue
    echo "$line" | grep -qiE '[:=]\s*.{8,}' 2>/dev/null && echo HIT
  done | grep -c HIT)
fi

hit_cmd=0
case "$TOOL" in
  bash|run_in_terminal)
    if [ -n "$CMD" ]; then
      # scan line-by-line: only exempt individual lines that themselves use ${...}
      # so a heredoc with a real secret + unrelated ${{ github.ref }} elsewhere cannot bypass
      if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(>|>>|<<|<<<|cat[[:space:]]|printf[[:space:]]|echo[[:space:]])' 2>/dev/null; then
        hit_cmd=$(echo "$CMD" | while IFS= read -r line; do
          echo "$line" | grep -qiE '(password|secret|token|api[_-]?key)\s*[:=]' 2>/dev/null || continue
          echo "$line" | sed -E 's/^.*[:=][[:space:]]*//' | grep -qE '^[$][{(]' 2>/dev/null && continue
          echo "$line" | grep -qiE '[:=]\s*[^$[:space:]][^[:space:]]{7,}' 2>/dev/null && echo HIT
        done | grep -c HIT)
      fi
    fi
    ;;
esac

if [ "${hit_content:-0}" -gt 0 ] || [ "${hit_cmd:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
  R='Blocked: hardcoded secret detected. Use GitHub Secrets (${ secrets.NAME }) instead.'
  AC='REPOSITORY POLICY: hardcoded secrets are not permitted in any write path, including shell redirects/heredocs. Do NOT retry through alternate tools. Replace literal secret values with GitHub Actions secrets context references.'
  jq -n --arg r "$R" --arg ac "$AC" '{permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r,additionalContext:$ac,hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r,additionalContext:$ac}}'
else
  echo '{}'
fi

preToolUse.description: Guard destructive ops; allow CI archival (CLI + VS Code) — denies with session-level additionalContext per v4 pattern
preToolUse.bash:
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cat <<'JSON_EOF'
{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Hook enforcement unavailable: jq is not installed. Install jq (brew install jq / apt install jq / choco install jq).","additionalContext":"REPOSITORY POLICY: enforcement hooks require jq. Do NOT retry via alternate tools. Install jq and re-run.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Hook enforcement unavailable: jq is not installed."}}
JSON_EOF
  exit 0
fi
INPUT=$(cat)
ARGS=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -c 'if (.toolArgs|type)=="string" then (try (.toolArgs|fromjson) catch {}) elif (.toolArgs|type)=="object" then .toolArgs elif (.tool_input|type)=="object" then .tool_input else {} end' 2>/dev/null)
CMD=$(echo "$ARGS" | jq -r '.command // empty' 2>/dev/null)
[ -z "$CMD" ] && { echo '{}'; exit 0; }

allow_ci_src_regex='^(Jenkinsfile|\.travis\.yml|\.gitlab-ci\.yml|\.drone\.yml|bitbucket-pipelines\.yml|azure-pipelines\.yml|bamboo-specs/.+|\.circleci/.+)$'
denied=0
reason=''

is_ci_archive() {
  case "$1" in
    .github/ci-archive|.github/ci-archive/*|*/.github/ci-archive|*/.github/ci-archive/*) return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 1
}

set_deny() {
  denied=1
  reason="$1"
}

while IFS= read -r raw; do
  seg=$(echo "$raw" | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$//g')
  [ -z "$seg" ] && continue

  op=''
  echo "$seg" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])find[[:space:]].*-delete([[:space:]]|$)' && op='finddelete'
  [ -z "$op" ] && echo "$seg" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])(sudo[[:space:]]+|command[[:space:]]+|builtin[[:space:]]+|/usr/bin/env[[:space:]]+)*(\/bin\/|\/usr\/bin\/)?rm([[:space:]]|$)' && op='rm'
  [ -z "$op" ] && echo "$seg" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])(sudo[[:space:]]+|command[[:space:]]+|builtin[[:space:]]+|/usr/bin/env[[:space:]]+)*(\/bin\/|\/usr\/bin\/)?unlink([[:space:]]|$)' && op='unlink'
  [ -z "$op" ] && echo "$seg" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+rm([[:space:]]|$)' && op='gitrm'
  [ -z "$op" ] && echo "$seg" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+mv([[:space:]]|$)' && op='gitmv'
  [ -z "$op" ] && echo "$seg" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])(sudo[[:space:]]+|command[[:space:]]+|builtin[[:space:]]+|/usr/bin/env[[:space:]]+)*(\/bin\/|\/usr\/bin\/)?mv([[:space:]]|$)' && op='mv'
  [ -z "$op" ] && continue

  seg_clean=$(echo "$seg" | sed -E 's/[0-9]?>>?&?[0-9-]+//g; s/[0-9]?>>?[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]+//g; s/<[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]+//g')
  toks=$(echo "$seg_clean" | tr -s ' ' '\n' | grep -vE '^(sudo|command|builtin|/usr/bin/env|git|rm|mv|unlink|/bin/rm|/usr/bin/rm|/bin/mv|/usr/bin/mv|find|-delete|-[a-zA-Z]+|--[a-zA-Z-]+|>|>>|<|2>|2>&1|&>)$' | grep -v '^$')

  for t in $toks; do
    bare="${t#./}"
    case "$bare" in *..*) set_deny 'Blocked: path traversal (..) not allowed in destructive operations.' ;; esac
    [ "$denied" -eq 1 ] && break
  done
  [ "$denied" -eq 1 ] && break

  case "$op" in
    rm|unlink|gitrm|finddelete)
      for t in $toks; do
        bare="${t#./}"
        [ "$bare" = "." ] && continue
        is_ci_archive "$bare" && continue
        set_deny "Blocked: deletion outside .github/ci-archive/ is not allowed (${bare})."
        break
      done
      ;;
    mv|gitmv)
      # last operand is destination; ALL preceding tokens are sources.
      # each source must be a recognised CI source (or already under ci-archive).
      dst=$(echo "$toks" | tail -1)
      dst="${dst#./}"
      is_ci_archive "$dst" || set_deny "Blocked: move destination must be under .github/ci-archive/ (${dst})."
      if [ "$denied" -eq 0 ]; then
        src_count=$(echo "$toks" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
        srcs=$(echo "$toks" | head -n $((src_count-1)))
        for src in $srcs; do
          src="${src#./}"
          if is_ci_archive "$src"; then continue; fi
          if echo "$src" | grep -qE "$allow_ci_src_regex"; then continue; fi
          set_deny "Blocked: only CI source files may be moved to archive (${src})."
          break
        done
      fi
      ;;
  esac

  [ "$denied" -eq 1 ] && break
done <<< "$(echo "$CMD" | tr ';|&' '\n')"

if [ "$denied" -eq 1 ]; then
  AC='REPOSITORY POLICY: destructive operations are restricted. Only CI-source archival into .github/ci-archive/ is allowed; standalone deletion outside archive is blocked.'
  jq -n --arg r "$reason" --arg ac "$AC" '{permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r,additionalContext:$ac,hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r,additionalContext:$ac}}'
else
  echo '{}'
fi

postToolUse.description: Quality check + actionlint on workflow writes (CLI + VS Code)
postToolUse.bash:
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '{"additionalContext":"WARNING: migration quality check skipped because jq is not installed. Install jq to enable enforcement.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"WARNING: migration quality check skipped because jq is not installed."}}'
  exit 0
fi
INPUT=$(cat)
ARGS=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -c 'if (.toolArgs|type)=="string" then (try (.toolArgs|fromjson) catch {}) elif (.toolArgs|type)=="object" then .toolArgs elif (.tool_input|type)=="object" then .tool_input else {} end' 2>/dev/null)
FILE=$(echo "$ARGS" | jq -r '.filePath // .path // .file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)
echo "$FILE" | grep -q '.github/workflows/' || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }
[ -f "$FILE" ] || { echo '{}'; exit 0; }

has_unpinned_external() {
  awk '
    /uses:[[:space:]]*/ {
      ref=$0
      sub(/.*uses:[[:space:]]*/, "", ref)
      sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, "", ref)
      gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", ref)
      if (ref ~ /^\.?\//) next
      if (ref ~ /^docker:\/\//) next
      if (ref !~ /@/) next
      n=split(ref,a,"@"); v=a[n]
      if (v !~ /^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/) bad=1
    }
    END { exit bad ? 0 : 1 }
  ' "$1"
}

W=''
has_unpinned_external "$FILE" && W="${W}unpinned-actions; "
grep -qiE '(TODO|FIXME|CHANGEME|PLACEHOLDER|XXX)' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && W="${W}placeholder-text; "
grep -qE 'permissions:\s*write-all' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && W="${W}write-all-permissions; "
grep -qE '^permissions:' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || W="${W}missing-permissions-block; "

L=''
if command -v actionlint >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  L=$(actionlint "$FILE" 2>&1 | head -5 | tr '\n' ' ')
fi

if [ -n "$W" ] || [ -n "$L" ]; then
  MSG="MIGRATION QUALITY CHECK ($FILE): ${W}"
  [ -n "$L" ] && MSG="${MSG}actionlint: ${L}"
  jq -n --arg m "$MSG" '{additionalContext:$m,hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$m}}'
else
  echo '{}'
fi

agentStop.bash:
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Migration quality gate unavailable: jq is not installed. Install jq and re-run.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"AgentStop","decision":"block","reason":"Migration quality gate unavailable: jq is not installed."}}'
  exit 0
fi
scan_workflows() {
  CWD="$1"
  LA=0
  command -v actionlint >/dev/null 2>&1 && LA=1
  ISSUES=''
  TOTAL=0; CLEAN=0; BAD=0; DETAILS=''
  for f in "$CWD"/.github/workflows/*.yml "$CWD"/.github/workflows/*.yaml; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    TOTAL=$((TOTAL+1))
    FN=$(basename "$f")
    W=''
    awk '
      /uses:[[:space:]]*/ {
        ref=$0
        sub(/.*uses:[[:space:]]*/, "", ref)
        sub(/[[:space:]]*#.*/, "", ref)
        gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", ref)
        if (ref ~ /^\.?\//) next
        if (ref ~ /^docker:\/\//) next
        if (ref !~ /@/) next
        n=split(ref,a,"@"); v=a[n]
        if (v !~ /^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$/) bad=1
      }
      END { exit bad ? 0 : 1 }
    ' "$f" && W="${W}unpinned-actions "
    grep -qiE '(TODO|FIXME|CHANGEME|PLACEHOLDER|XXX)' "$f" 2>/dev/null && W="${W}placeholders "
    grep -qE 'permissions:\s*write-all' "$f" 2>/dev/null && W="${W}write-all "
    grep -qE '^permissions:' "$f" 2>/dev/null || W="${W}no-permissions "
    [ "$LA" -eq 1 ] && ! actionlint "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && W="${W}actionlint-errors "

    if [ -n "$W" ]; then
      BAD=$((BAD+1))
      ISSUES="${ISSUES}${FN}: ${W}; "
      W2=$(echo "$W" | sed -E 's/[[:space:]]+$//' | sed 's/ /, /g')
      DETAILS="${DETAILS}| ${FN} | ${W2} |\n"
    else
      CLEAN=$((CLEAN+1))
      DETAILS="${DETAILS}| ${FN} | clean |\n"
    fi
  done
}

INPUT=$(cat)
SID=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.sessionId // .session_id // "default"' 2>/dev/null)
CWD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // ""' 2>/dev/null)
[ -z "$CWD" ] && CWD="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$PWD}"
CF="/tmp/.migration-quality-gate-${SID}"
COUNT=$(cat "$CF" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
COUNT=$((COUNT+1))
echo "$COUNT" > "$CF"
if [ "$COUNT" -gt 3 ]; then
  rm -f "$CF"
  echo '{}'
  exit 0
fi

scan_workflows "$CWD"

if [ -n "$ISSUES" ]; then
  R="Migration quality gate FAILED (attempt ${COUNT}/3): ${ISSUES}Fix these before completing."
  jq -n --arg r "$R" '{decision:"block",reason:$r,hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"AgentStop",decision:"block",reason:$r}}'
else
  rm -f "$CF"
  echo '{}'
fi

INPUT=$(cat)

mkdir -p "$CWD/.github"
SC="$CWD/.github/MIGRATION-SCORECARD.md"
NOW=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
{
  echo "## ${NOW}"
  echo "- session: ${SESSION}"
  echo "- reason: ${REASON}"
  echo "- workflows: total=${TOTAL}, clean=${CLEAN}, with_issues=${BAD}"
  echo
  echo "| workflow | status |"
  echo "|---|---|"

rm -f "/tmp/.migration-quality-gate-${SESSION}" /tmp/.migration-quality-gate
find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name '.migration-quality-gate-*' -type f -mmin +240 -delete 2>/dev/null || true

INPUT=$(cat)
